*   Use "voxel cache (es)" for datasets with many invisible labels and moderate dimensions, but avoid for very large datasets like H01 where the bit vector overhead dominates [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the 'voxel cache (es)' mode improves render times for datasets like CELLS and AZBA (which have small label regions/few stop bits, implying many invisible labels relative to the cache efficiency or specific workload characteristics mentioned) but performance decreases significantly for H01. The text attributes this decrease to the large dimensions of H01 causing distant memory reads in the longer empty space bit vector and the overhead of querying fine LODs. The frame time data supports this: H01 jumps from 1.2ms (voxel cache) to 75.8ms (voxel cache (es)), while CELLS improves from 9.7ms to 6.1ms.
